title: A Study to Identify Markers in Blood and Tissue of HPV Clearance
brief_summary: This is a research study looking at gene characteristics in blood and Pap smear samples in hopes of identifying markers that will predict if the HPV infection is present or not.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HPV positive

Exclusion Criteria:

* Negative for HPV
study_population: HPV-positive women with biopsy-confirmed CIN 1 or negative biopsies or normal colposcopic findings
